terms.title: Emperor
terms.how_came_to_power: Hereditary: acclaimed Emperor on 12 Oct 1822, after proclaiming independence on 7 Sep 1822; no popular vote.
terms.party_or_base: Braganza dynasty; Portuguese-born court circle and Brazilian landowning/merchant elite.
terms.notes: Emperor held the moderating power under the 1824 Constitution he imposed after dissolving the Constituent Assembly; abdicated 7 Apr 1831 in favour of his 5-year-old son.
